text: On weekdays it's fairly predictable. I get up at seven, have classes until about two, and then spend the afternoon studying in the library or working part-time at a café. Evenings are the only time I really have to myself, so I try to keep them free for sport or seeing friends.

tips.en: Morning, afternoon, evening — easy for the listener to follow.
tips.kk: Таң, күн, кеш — тыңдаушыға ілесу оңай.
tips.ru: Утро, день, вечер — слушателю легко следить.
tips.example: I get up at seven, have classes until about two

tips.en: The only time I really have to myself adds a personal attitude.
tips.kk: The only time I really have to myself көзқарас қосады.
tips.ru: The only time I really have to myself добавляет отношение.
tips.example: Evenings are the only time I really have to myself

questions.question: What does a typical day look like for you?

text: Definitely a morning person. My head is clearest before ten, so I do my hardest tasks, like IELTS writing practice, first thing. By nine in the evening I'm pretty useless for anything serious — I'd rather watch something light or read than try to concentrate.

tips.en: Like IELTS writing practice gives a concrete detail instead of general words.
tips.kk: Like IELTS writing practice — жалпы сөз орнына нақтылық.
tips.ru: Like IELTS writing practice — конкретика вместо общих слов.

tips.en: Pretty useless is a light joke about yourself and sounds natural.
tips.kk: Pretty useless — өзіне жеңіл әзіл, табиғи естіледі.
tips.ru: Pretty useless — лёгкая шутка над собой, звучит естественно.
tips.example: I'm pretty useless for anything serious

note.en: “At the very start of the day”.

questions.question: Are you a morning person or an evening person?

text: Probably early evening, when I've finished everything I had to do and the rest of the day is mine. In summer I like going for a walk along the river at that time, when the heat has gone and the whole city seems to slow down a little.

tips.en: Not just “evening” but why it feels good.
tips.kk: Жай «кеш» емес, оның неге жағымды екені.
tips.ru: Не просто «вечер», а почему он приятен.
tips.example: the rest of the day is mine

tips.en: The whole city seems to slow down is vivid, descriptive language.
tips.kk: The whole city seems to slow down — бейнелі, жанды сөздер.
tips.ru: The whole city seems to slow down — образная, живая лексика.
tips.example: the whole city seems to slow down a little

questions.question: What is your favourite part of the day?

text: Quite a lot, yes. When I was at school, every hour was planned for me, whereas now I have to organise my own time, which was a real challenge at first. I've gradually learned to plan my week on Sunday evenings, and that has made everything much less stressful.

tips.en: Whereas clearly contrasts school with the present.
tips.kk: Whereas мектеп пен қазірді анық қарама-қарсы қояды.
tips.ru: Whereas чётко противопоставляет школу и настоящее.
tips.example: whereas now I have to organise my own time

tips.en: The present perfect shows the result: planning helped.
tips.kk: Present perfect нәтижені көрсетеді: жоспарлау көмектесті.
tips.ru: Present perfect показывает результат: планирование помогло.
tips.example: that has made everything much less stressful

questions.question: Has your routine changed in recent years?

text: Up to a point. A basic routine saves a lot of energy, because you don't have to decide every little thing, like when to exercise or study. But if every day is exactly the same, life gets a bit dull, so I like to leave room for something spontaneous at weekends.

tips.en: Up to a point means “yes, but”, and both sides follow.
tips.kk: Up to a point — «иә, бірақ»; одан кейін екі жағы.
tips.ru: Up to a point — «да, но»; дальше обе стороны.

tips.en: Leave room for leads to a balanced conclusion.
tips.kk: Leave room for — алтын орта туралы қорытынды.
tips.ru: Leave room for — вывод о золотой середине.
tips.example: I like to leave room for something spontaneous

questions.question: Do you think it's important to have a routine?
